regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative regime: Coal leads with score 1.095 (durability 0.54, crowded false) and Banks are the only challenger (0.78 durability but crowded at 1.74z). Only 2 of 22 themes are trend-gate eligible, and the gate itself did NOT help historically on this market (mean-reverting tape), so the detector's one validated edge is absent here — this is a low-conviction, display-only read for this tape.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff: only if Banks overtakes Coal in score AND rotation.margin turns negative AND crowding_z drops below 1.5 would I retire the 'no handoff' watch and consider an overweight.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the clear leader with the highest rank score (1.095) and is the only trend-gate-eligible non-crowded theme, making it the least-bad expression of the current one-narrative regime. Its durability_bar (0.54) is middling and breadth is only 0.5, so this is a 'respect the tape, not a deep fundamental view' lean. The gate-leg being true supports staying long over the horizon, while crowding-leg (0.78z, not crowded) removes a size-down caution.
theses.dissent: The coal leadership is a mean-reverting tape (hurst_tag='mean-revert') and breadth is only half the universe; a sharp yuan/commodity macro surprise could snap the lead hard given 75% unscheduled macro narrative share.

falsifier.text: Coal lags the CSI 300 by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only viable challenger (score 1.03, durability 0.78, breadth 0.944) and are trend-gate eligible, but the crowding flag (1.74z, crowded=true) triggers the explicit guardrail to cap, not chase. With the rotation margin between Coal and Banks only 0.065 and rotation marked directional=false, there is no confirmed handoff to justify adding fresh longs here.
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest trend-health (hurst_tag='trend') and near-universal breadth, so if crowding unwinds via a broad rotation rather than a fade, they could be the next leader — but that is a next-narrative call the detector forbids.

falsifier.text: Banks remains crowded (crowding_z above 1.5) and fails to close the rotation margin with Coal for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
